kind: estimate (FCFS replay, cap-invariant v4 C=8 hold times)

leakage_guard.allowed_inputs: v4 runs with path == gateway and cap == 8
leakage_guard.excluded: all v4 R3 direct runs (observed max concurrency 9–14 at L=200: cap never binds, so they are de-facto C=16/32 measurements); all v5 data (none exists)

model.service: per-class resample of v4 C=8 gateway hold times [t_sent, t_terminal)

status: FROZEN with the v5 freeze commit; written before any v5 GPU run

tolerances.cell_rule: |mean_obs - mean_pred| <= max(5 ms, rho * mean_pred) over the 10 seeds, per arm
tolerances.envelope: cells outside the validated envelope (L = 400, or predicted mean above the LOSO range) are scored and reported but labelled extrapolated and excluded from the H3 verdict
tolerances.pass_rule: a (cell, arm) prediction PASSES iff the cell rule holds AND >= 8/10 seeds meet the seed rule
tolerances.pi90_coverage: descriptive only (LOSO coverage was 0.57: the interval reflects hold resampling only)
tolerances.seed_rule: |obs - pred| <= max(tau_abs, rho * pred) per (cell, arm, seed); tau_abs = max(5 ms, q95 |LOSO err|), rho = q95 |LOSO err|/obs over LOSO runs with obs >= 5 ms
